name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run a weekly automated scan of all prompts in our system, flagging duplicates, weak phrasing, or outdated references. This keeps our prompts sharp and consistent without slowing us down. The trade-off is upfront setup time, but it pays off by preventing drift and wasted effort later.

name: Gauge
text: A weekly scan risks review fatigue—reviewers gloss over prompts when flooded with low-signal alerts. Instead, tie scans to deployments: auto-flag only prompts with high-confidence issues (e.g., broken references) and let humans review the rest. Settle it by running a 2-week pilot comparing false-positive rates between the two approaches.
